facts.recommendationText: Decompose cost drivers and identify margin-recovery levers Locate the specific drivers of margin decline before any pricing or cost action A cost-driver decomposition is analysis-only, low-cost, and reversible; it avoids blanket price hikes or cuts that could harm volume or quality. Margin is eroding; targeted diagnosis must precede any price/cost change Split margin change into COGS, labor, overhead, and price/mix contributions over recent periods. Top 3 margin-erosion drivers quantified Identify low-risk levers (supplier terms, waste reduction, mix) — no blanket price change. Reversible levers shortlisted with expected margin impact
